Summarize the runs

Source: R/summarize_runs.R
summarize_runs.Rd

Summarizes the solutions of the last level of each run (scenario x ordering), for any number of satellite accounts and priority levels. No plots are produced.

Usage

summarize_runs(runs, tol = 1e-06, goal_tol = 1e-09)

Arguments

runs

A lexio_results object (run_model()) or a list of gp_run objects (run_experiment()) of the same model.

tol

Tolerance (absolute, max norm on x_star) to group states.

goal_tol

Relative tolerance to call an account "at goal".

Value

List with runs (one row per run; infeasible_level is the first level without solution, NA if none), levels (one row per run x priority level: its goals, optimum Z, GLPK status and the violation of its constraints by the solution, see run_experiment()), goals (run x account) and states (one row per distinct state).

Details

For each run, with x0 the base output and b = D x0 the base of each account:

  • delta_x = sum(x_star) - sum(x0) and delta_x_pct = delta_x / sum(x0);

  • for each account: achieved Gx, delta = Gx - b, intended change g - b and realized share (Gx - b) / (g - b); the share is NA when the intended change is negligible (|g - b| <= 1e-9 max(1, |b|), a goal equal to the base up to rounding);

  • distinct states: single-linkage grouping of the solutions x_star of all runs; two solutions are in the same state when max |x_star_a - x_star_b| <= tol (1e-6 by default). A run with a level that has no solution has no state (NA).
